results.title: OpenCode
results.description: OpenCode is an open-source, provider-agnostic AI coding agent that offers LSP support, focuses on a terminal user interface (TUI), and utilizes a client/server architecture for flexible development.

results.title: Opencode
results.description: Opencode is an AI coding agent designed for the terminal, assisting developers in understanding, building, and modifying codebases.

results.title: Opencode SDK
results.description: Official TypeScript library providing convenient access to the Opencode REST API with support for streaming responses, comprehensive error handling, and automatic retries.

results.title: OpenCode (DeepWiki)
results.description: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent and developer platform that provides provider-agnostic AI assistance across terminal, desktop, and IDE interfaces.

results.title: OpenCode RS
results.description: OpenCode RS is a Rust SDK providing a native interface to OpenCode's HTTP REST API and SSE streaming capabilities for hybrid client-server applications.
